title: Anonymous USAF colonel and fighter pilot's UFO encounter

tellings.quote: he had a really dramatic UFO encounter in 1980 or something like that.

plain: A filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, James Fox, says he knows a colonel and fighter pilot in the US Air Force, whom he does not name. Fox says this man told him he had a very dramatic UFO encounter around 1980, the kind of account that matters because it comes from a trained military flyer.
